This guy in London trying to find the right electrical line
Fuck that shit. How the fuck are you supposed to find the right wire in all that mess?
Someone needs to work on their cabling

I've worked on equipment just like that or worse at times. By the way it is phone lines; low voltage electrical.

Stuff like this is caused by years and years of sloppy jobs getting compiled up on each other. It usually starts with one sloppy job or a bad original cable design, as time goes by it keeps adding up. Eventually you have no option but to keep doing a sloppy job. The only way to fix all of it would be to take down service to many many customers all at once for a long period of time, while you redo everything.

Finding the right wire or line is actually not as bad as it looks. See the odd looking tool the guy is holding in his right hand. That's called a tester or at times it's also known as a sniffer. It is used in conjunction with another tool called a toner. The toner inserts an electrical pulse/signal into the the wire you are trying to locate at one end. Then you use the tester which has a speaker built into it to locate that signal. The tester will pic up the signal and convert that electrical signal into an audible sound which also gets louder as you get closer to the right wire your looking for. With a little probing and listening you find the right wire in no time.
